market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. $90bn weekly ASX loss, AUD weakness, oil spike and iron ore decline create a hostile risk environment. RBA rate rise fears dominate. Expect continued volatility in ^AXJO and ^AORD. Energy outperforms; materials and consumer lag.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may create entry points for first-home buyers and property developers by late 2026. AI capex question resolves over 6-12 months. Iron ore stabilisation likely if China stimulus materialises. Superannuation reform debate could create structural tailwinds for fund managers.
